top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Sees Smaller Economic Slump as More Oil Reaches Market
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia now expects its economy to shrink 2.1% this year instead of 3.6%, after recovering enough oil exports to mitigate some of the damage caused by the Iran war. The revised forecast, announced in Tuesday's budget statement, is a considerable improvement from last month, but before the war began, Saudi Arabia had been expecting economic growth of approximately 4.5%. Saudi oil exports in October were the highest since the war began. Aramco has been moving more crude through its East-West pipeline to Yanbu on the Red Sea to offset shipments…

top_signals.summary: ARA Rotterdam’s LNG bunker price has risen in line with TTF. Front-month TTF has climbed by $1.05/MMBtu ($55/mt) to $29.64/MMBtu ($1,541/mt).
